text:
maya: All-hands live! If you're in the SF office, I'm setting up a tiny snack altar in the breakroom. I brought a mysterious jar labeled 'Macaroni & feelings'. Come grab one if you dare 😂
omar: bless you, maya. what's the beverage situation? coffee or kombucha? :coffee:
lena: I'll bring coffee. Also voting to rename the mascot "Mac the Macaroni". :macaroni:
sam: Mac + mascot, yes. Also +1 for kombucha if it's the ginger one.
ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands on stage in 2 mins. Please mute if not presenting. (automated)
rebecca: clapping from my living room :clap: :clap: love the vibe!
noah: If anyone posts a pic of the macaroni, I will start a meme thread. Consider yourself warned. :camera:
maya: pic incoming. [https://example.com/jar-macaroni.jpg] (pretend it's a jar of glitter mac & cheese)
omar: OMG that jar is a mood. Reaction: :spiral_notepad: for meeting notes, :tada: for macaroni
lena: quick poll — what should we chant after the CEO mic drop? :thumbsup: "Redwood rules"  :heart: "Redwood for snacks"  :laughing: "Mac Attack"
sam: :heart: for snacks
rebecca: :laughing: Mac Attack forever
noah: :thumbsup: Redwood rules (i like a clean chant)
maya: someone's already started it in the breakroom. audio levels: 3/10. GIF: https://giphy.com/silly-macaroni
omar: also shoutout to infra for fixing the deploy hiccup earlier — tiny clap emoji :clap:
lena: kudos! real applause :tada:
ops-bot: Poll created: "All-hands afterparty song?" Options: 1) "Don't Stop Believin'" 2) "Dance Monkey" 3) "Boogie Wonderland" Vote with emoji 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣
sam: 2️⃣ (sorry)
rebecca: 3️⃣ let's boogie
noah: 1️⃣ for the classic
maya: voting 2️⃣ but only if we play the ukulele cover
omar: can confirm a ukulele cover is possible. (random)
lena: also, tiny logistics: if you're remote and want a macaroni care package, DM me your address today.
rebecca: done — thanks lena!
sam: can someone save me a jar? I promise to share code reviews in exchange 😏
noah: barter accepted. +1 meme thread if you deliver.
maya: ok closing this jar listing. See y'all in the stream. :microphone: :sparkles:
